description: Registry of key Large Language Model papers and how they relate to one another. This file is intentionally kept at the repository root (parallel to the individual paper folders), because it describes cross-paper relationships rather than the internals of any single paper. The reading list is drawn from widely-cited curations, notably 'Essential LLM Papers' (Foundation Models Deep Dive) and other canonical roadmaps.

schema.papers[].id: stable short identifier used in citation edges
schema.papers[].folder: path to the self-contained folder for this paper, or null if not yet reproduced
schema.papers[].status: 'reproduced' (a folder exists in this repo) or 'planned' (on the roadmap)
schema.papers[].category: thematic grouping used by the citation graph
schema.citations[]: directed edge {from, to}: paper `from` cites / builds on paper `to` (both are ids in papers[]). Edges are representative of well-documented influence, not an exhaustive reference-list scrape.

papers.title: Attention Is All You Need
papers.summary: Introduces the Transformer, dispensing with recurrence and convolution in favor of pure attention.

papers.title: BERT: Pre-training of Deep Bidirectional Transformers for Language Understanding
papers.summary: Bidirectional encoder pretrained with masked language modeling; established the pretrain-then-finetune paradigm.

papers.title: Improving Language Understanding by Generative Pre-Training (GPT-1)
papers.summary: Decoder-only generative pretraining followed by supervised fine-tuning; origin of the GPT line.

papers.title: Language Models are Unsupervised Multitask Learners (GPT-2)
papers.summary: Scaled decoder-only LM showing strong zero-shot task transfer from language modeling alone.

papers.title: Language Models are Few-Shot Learners (GPT-3)
papers.summary: 175B-parameter model demonstrating in-context few-shot learning without gradient updates.

papers.title: Exploring the Limits of Transfer Learning with a Unified Text-to-Text Transformer (T5)
papers.summary: Casts every NLP task as text-to-text and systematically studies transfer-learning choices.

papers.title: Scaling Laws for Neural Language Models
papers.folder: Scaling Laws for Neural Language Models
papers.summary: Characterizes smooth power-law relationships between loss and model/data/compute scale.

papers.title: Training Compute-Optimal Large Language Models (Chinchilla)
papers.summary: Shows most LLMs are undertrained; model size and data should scale roughly equally.

papers.title: RoFormer: Enhanced Transformer with Rotary Position Embedding (RoPE)
papers.summary: Rotary position embeddings that encode relative position and extrapolate to longer sequences.

papers.title: FlashAttention: Fast and Memory-Efficient Exact Attention with IO-Awareness
papers.summary: IO-aware exact attention that is faster and far more memory-efficient than standard implementations.

papers.title: Switch Transformers: Scaling to Trillion Parameter Models with Simple and Efficient Sparsity
papers.summary: Sparse mixture-of-experts routing that scales parameter count while keeping per-token compute low.

papers.title: PaLM: Scaling Language Modeling with Pathways
papers.summary: 540B-parameter model with strong reasoning and code performance, trained via the Pathways system.

papers.title: LLaMA: Open and Efficient Foundation Language Models
papers.summary: Open, compute-efficient foundation models trained on public data; catalyzed open-source LLMs.

papers.title: Llama 2: Open Foundation and Fine-Tuned Chat Models
papers.summary: Commercially usable open models with instruction-tuned chat variants aligned via RLHF.

papers.title: Training Language Models to Follow Instructions with Human Feedback (InstructGPT)
papers.summary: Aligns GPT-3 to user intent via SFT + reward modeling + PPO; direct ancestor of ChatGPT.

papers.title: Deep Reinforcement Learning from Human Preferences
papers.summary: Foundational method for learning reward models from human preference comparisons.

papers.title: Constitutional AI: Harmlessness from AI Feedback
papers.summary: Uses AI feedback against a set of principles to reduce reliance on human harm labels.

papers.title: Direct Preference Optimization: Your Language Model is Secretly a Reward Model
papers.summary: Reframes RLHF as a simple classification loss, removing the separate reward model and RL loop.

papers.title: Retrieval-Augmented Generation for Knowledge-Intensive NLP Tasks
papers.summary: Conditions generation on retrieved documents to ground outputs and reduce hallucination.

papers.title: LoRA: Low-Rank Adaptation of Large Language Models
papers.summary: Freezes base weights and learns small low-rank updates, cutting trainable parameters by orders of magnitude.

papers.title: QLoRA: Efficient Finetuning of Quantized LLMs
papers.summary: Combines 4-bit quantization with LoRA to fine-tune very large models on a single GPU.

papers.title: Chain-of-Thought Prompting Elicits Reasoning in Large Language Models
papers.summary: Eliciting intermediate reasoning steps dramatically improves multi-step problem solving.

papers.title: Self-Consistency Improves Chain of Thought Reasoning in Language Models
papers.summary: Samples multiple reasoning paths and takes a majority vote to boost reasoning accuracy.

papers.title: Tree of Thoughts: Deliberate Problem Solving with Large Language Models
papers.summary: Frames reasoning as search over a tree of steps with evaluation and backtracking.

papers.title: ReAct: Synergizing Reasoning and Acting in Language Models
papers.summary: Interleaves reasoning traces with actions/tool calls, foundational for LLM agents.

papers.title: DeepSeek-R1: Incentivizing Reasoning Capability in LLMs via Reinforcement Learning
papers.summary: Uses large-scale RL to incentivize long chain-of-thought reasoning in open models.

papers.title: Learning Transferable Visual Models From Natural Language Supervision (CLIP)
papers.summary: Contrastively aligns image and text encoders, enabling zero-shot visual classification.

papers.title: Flamingo: a Visual Language Model for Few-Shot Learning
papers.summary: Bridges a frozen vision encoder and frozen LLM via cross-attention for few-shot multimodal tasks.
